candidates.headline: Source: Bills releasing veterans Hardman, Wishnowsky
candidates.description: The Bills are releasing veteran returner and wide receiver Mecole Hardman Jr., a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler. A source also confirmed to ESPN that the team is releasing veteran punter Mitch Wishnowsky.

candidates.headline: Sources: Giants trade for DT CJ Okoye from Ravens for '28 pick
candidates.description: The Giants have acquired defensive tackle CJ Okoye from the Ravens for a 2028 seventh-round pick, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.

candidates.headline: Bucs GM Jason Licht 'optimistic' about re-signing Baker Mayfield
candidates.description: Buccaneers general manager Jason Licht said Friday that he is "very optimistic" about quarterback Baker Mayfield playing in Tampa beyond the 2026 season despite Mayfield saying he felt "disrespected" by the Bucs' initial offer.

candidates.headline: Polymarket withdraws market on Mahomes' return from injury
candidates.description: Polymarket US said it withdrew plans to offer trading on Patrick Mahomes' return to the field, a type of market the NFL says should be prohibited.
